**Proposed change:**
- `BATT_LOW_VOLT` = **10.0 V** (was 10.5 V)
- Definition: "Battery low voltage failsafe threshold", unit V, valid range 0.0–60.0 V
- Docs: https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/parameters.html#BATT_LOW_VOLT

**One thing worth checking:** there's a separate, lower threshold — `BATT_CRT_VOLT` ("Battery critical voltage failsafe threshold", also 0.0–60.0 V, https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/parameters.html#BATT_CRT_VOLT). The critical level is normally set *below* the low level, so if your critical threshold is currently at or above 10.0 V, the two would be out of order. I haven't changed it — let me know if you'd like me to look up its current value and propose an adjustment.

`BATT_CRT_VOLT` is currently **9.6 V**, which is correctly below your new 10.0 V low-voltage threshold — so the ordering is fine and no change is needed there.

**Summary of the proposal awaiting your confirmation:**

| Parameter | Current | Proposed | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BATT_LOW_VOLT` | 10.5 V | **10.0 V** | Low-voltage failsafe threshold, valid range 0.0–60.0 V |
| `BATT_CRT_VOLT` | 9.6 V | *(unchanged)* | Already below the new low threshold — correct ordering |

Source for both parameter definitions: https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/parameters.html#BATT_LOW_VOLT

The proposal for `WPNAV_SPEED = 800` has been created for your review — it's not applied to the vehicle until you confirm it in the UI. No reboot is needed for this change.

A couple of things worth knowing:

- **This is the default horizontal speed for waypoint legs.** If your mission planner sets per-waypoint speeds, those will still override this value on those legs.
- **800 cm/s is a real speed for a copter.** Make sure your airframe can actually fly that fast safely — the parameter allows up to 2000 cm/s, but that doesn't mean your vehicle should. If you're seeing the vehicle fall behind on long legs, also consider `WPNAV_ACCEL` (waypoint acceleration) and `WPNAV_JERK`, which control how quickly it reaches the target speed.

Parameter reference: https://ardupilot.org/copter/docs/parameters.html#WPNAV_SPEED
